title: An integer series of currents with locally summable masses defines a current with the mass bound
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T_r ∈ D_n(U) (r ∈ ℕ) arbitrary currents (GeometricCurrentOn U n, not necessarily integer multiplicity) and c_r ∈ ℤ such that Σ'_r |c_r|·M_W(T_r) < ∞ in [0, ∞] for every open W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContainedOpen W U). Then there is S ∈ D_n(U) such that for every ω ∈ D^n(U) the series Σ_r c_r T_r(ω) has (unconditional) sum S(ω), i.e. HasSum (r ↦ c_r T_r(ω)) (S(ω)), and M_W(S) ≤ Σ'_r |c_r|·M_W(T_r) for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (c : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (T r).massOn W) < ∞) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω, HasSum (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * T r ω) (S ω)) ∧ ∀ W, S.massOn W ≤ ∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (T r).massOn W
